'''Jengus''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who left [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with his family after an entire Jawa clan was eliminated by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. Hoping to join his nephew [[Squig (Jawa)|Squig]], the family was stranded at [[Cordel Cove]] on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] due to [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repairs. In exchange for becoming the head technician for the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Jangus and his family were allowed free-rein of the facility.
